paścimete sāta bana kahiba ekhana || 66 ||
verses_en.wbw: yamunara purvakule — on the eastern bank of the Yamuna; achhe pancha vana — there are five forests; pashchimete sata vana — on the western seven forests; kahiba ekhana — I will tell now

verses_en.text:
In these twelve forests are Krishna's pastimes;
apart from devotees no one knows their secret.
verses_en.orig:
কৃষ্ণের বিহার এই দ্বাদশ বনে ।
ভক্ত বিনে কেহো ইহার মরম না জানে ॥ ৬৭ ॥
verses_en.translit:
kṛṣṇera bihāra ei dbādaśa bane |
bhakta bine keho ihāra marama nā jāne || 67 ||
verses_en.wbw: krishnera vihara — Krishna's pastimes; ei dvadasha vane — in these twelve forests; bhakta vine — apart from devotees; keho ihara marama na jane — no one knows their secret

verses_en.text:
Here is Kamsa's palace — west of the Yamuna;
to the north of it is the forest named Vrindavana.
verses_en.orig:
কংসের সদন এই যমুনা-পশ্চিমে ।
তাহার উত্তরে বন বৃন্দাবন নামে ॥ ৬৮ ॥
verses_en.translit:
kaṃsera sadana ei yamunā-paścime |
tāhāra uttare bana bṛndābana nāme || 68 ||
verses_en.wbw: kamsera sadana ei — here is Kamsa's palace; yamuna-pashchime — west of the Yamuna; tahara uttare — to the north of it; vana vrindavana name — the forest named Vrindavana

verses_en.text:
From Mathura to it is one yojana of road;
of it I shall tell many secret things.
verses_en.orig:
মথুরা হইতে সেই যোজনেক পথ ।
অনেক রহস্য কথা কহিব তাহাত ॥ ৬৯ ॥
verses_en.translit:
mathurā haite sei yojaneka patha |
aneka rahasya kathā kahiba tāhāta || 69 ||
verses_en.wbw: mathura haite — from Mathura; sei yojaneka patha — it is a yojana's journey; aneka rahasya katha — many secret things; kahiba tahata — I will tell about it

verses_en.text:
To the south-west of it is a forest named Kumuda,
one and a quarter yojanas' journey from Mathura.
verses_en.orig:
কুমুদ নামে বন আছে তাহার নৈঋতে ।
সওয়া যোজন পথ মথুরা হইতে ॥ ৭০ ॥
verses_en.translit:
kumuda nāme bana āche tāhāra naiṛte |
saoẏā yojana patha mathurā haite || 70 ||
verses_en.wbw: kumuda name vana — the forest named Kumuda; achhe tahara nairite — lies south-west of it; saoya yojana patha — a yojana and a quarter's journey; mathura haite — from Mathura

verses_en.text:
South of it, Lord, is the Khadira-vana,
a yojana and a half's journey from Mathura.
verses_en.orig:
খদিরবন আছে প্রভু তাহার দক্ষিণে ।
দেড় যোজন পথ মথুরার সনে ॥ ৭১ ॥
verses_en.translit:
khadirabana āche prabhu tāhāra dakṣiṇe |
deṛa yojana patha mathurāra sane || 71 ||
verses_en.wbw: khadira-vana achhe prabhu — there is, Lord, the Khadira-vana; tahara dakshine — south of it; deda yojana patha — a yojana and a half's journey; mathurara sane — from Mathura

verses_en.text:
The Tala-vana, Lord, is south of Mathura:
from Mathura it is half a yojana away.
verses_en.orig:
তালবন আছে প্রভু দক্ষিণে মথুরার ।
অর্ধ যোজন ভূমি মথুরা তাহার ॥ ৭২ ॥
verses_en.translit:
tālabana āche prabhu dakṣiṇe mathurāra |
ardha yojana bhūmi mathurā tāhāra || 72 ||
verses_en.wbw: talavana achhe prabhu — there is, Lord, the Talavana; dakshine mathurara — south of Mathura; ardha yojana bhumi — half a yojana of land; mathura tahara — from Mathura to it

verses_en.text:
There is a stream — a river named Manasa-Ganga:
west of Vrindavana, north-east of Mathura.
verses_en.orig:
এক নদী-ধারা আছে মানসগঙ্গা নামে ।
বৃন্দাবন-পশ্চিমে সে মথুরা-ঈশানে ॥ ৭৩ ॥
verses_en.translit:
eka nadī-dhārā āche mānasagaṅgā nāme |
bṛndābana-paścime se mathurā-īśāne || 73 ||
verses_en.wbw: eka nadi-dhara achhe — there is a stream; manasaganga name — named Manasa-Ganga; vrindavana-pashchime se — west of Vrindavana; mathura-ishane — north-east of Mathura

verses_en.text:
From the Kamyaka-vana [it flows] towards Madhuvana
and west of the Kaliya-daha enters the Yamuna.
verses_en.orig:
কাম্যকবন হৈতে মধুবনের উদ্দেশ ।
কালীদহ-পশ্চিমে যমুনা পরবেশ ॥ ৭৪ ॥
verses_en.translit:
kāmyakabana haite madhubanera uddeśa |
kālīdaha-paścime yamunā parabeśa || 74 ||
verses_en.wbw: kamyaka-vana haite — from the Kamyaka-vana; madhuvanera uddesha — towards Madhuvana; kalidaha-pashchime — west of the Kaliya-daha; yamuna paravesha — entry into the Yamuna

verses_en.text:
There is also a stream named Sarasvati there:
north of Mathura it enters the Yamuna.
verses_en.orig:
সরস্বতী নামে এক ধারা আছে তাথে ।
মথুরার উত্তরে সে প্রবেশে যমুনাতে ॥ ৭৫ ॥
verses_en.translit:
sarasbatī nāme eka dhārā āche tāthe |
mathurāra uttare se prabeśe yamunāte || 75 ||
verses_en.wbw: sarasvati name eka dhara — a stream named Sarasvati; achhe tathe — is there; mathurara uttare — north of Mathura; se praveshe yamunate — it enters the Yamuna

verses_en.text:
West of Mathura is the hill of Govardhana,
three and a half yojanas, counting from Mathura.
verses_en.orig:
মথুরা-পশ্চিমে আছে গোবর্ধন-গিরি ।
আউট যোজন সে মথুরা হইতে ধরি' ॥ ৭৬ ॥
verses_en.translit:
mathurā-paścime āche gobardhana-giri |
āuṭa yojana se mathurā haite dhari' || 76 ||
verses_en.wbw: mathura-pashchime — west of Mathura; achhe govardhana-giri — is the hill of Govardhana; auta yojana — three and a half yojanas; se mathura haite dhari — reckoning from Mathura

verses_en.text:
I shall tell of the Kamyaka-vana — west of Govardhana:
from Mathura, as people reckon, three and a half yojanas.
verses_en.orig:
কহিব কাম্যকবন গোবর্ধন-পশ্চিমে ।
মথুরা হইতে আউট যোজন লোকে গণে ॥ ৭৭ ॥
verses_en.translit:
kahiba kāmyakabana gobardhana-paścime |
mathurā haite āuṭa yojana loke gaṇe || 77 ||
verses_en.wbw: kahiba kamyaka-vana — I will tell of the Kamyaka-vana; govardhana-pashchime — west of Govardhana; mathura haite — from Mathura; auta yojana loke gane — three and a half yojanas, as people reckon

verses_en.text:
The forest named Bahula is north-east of Mathura,
beyond the Manasa-Ganga, at two yojanas.
verses_en.orig:
বহুলা নামে বন আছে মথুরা-ঈশানে ।
মানসগঙ্গার পার সে দুই যোজনে ॥ ৭৮ ॥
verses_en.translit:
bahulā nāme bana āche mathurā-īśāne |
mānasagaṅgāra pāra se dui yojane || 78 ||
verses_en.wbw: bahula name vana — the forest named Bahula; achhe mathura-ishane — north-east of Mathura; manasagangara para — beyond the Manasa-Ganga; se dui yojane — at two yojanas

verses_en.text:
These are the seven forests west of the Yamuna;
now I shall tell of the five forests on the eastern bank.
verses_en.orig:
এই সাত বন সে পশ্চিমে যমুনার ।
কহিব ত পূর্বকূলে পাঁচ বন আর ॥ ৭৯ ॥
verses_en.translit:
ei sāta bana se paścime yamunāra |
kahiba ta pūrbakūle pāṁca bana āra || 79 ||
verses_en.wbw: ei sata vana — these seven forests; se pashchime yamunara — are west of the Yamuna; kahiba ta — I will tell now; purvakule pancha vana ara — of the five other forests on the eastern bank

verses_en.text:
The forest named Mahavana is near the Yamuna,
one yojana's journey from Mathura.
verses_en.orig:
মহাবন নামে বন যমুনা-নিকটে ।
মথুরা হইতে সেই যোজনেক বাটে ॥ ৮০ ॥
verses_en.translit:
mahābana nāme bana yamunā-nikaṭe |
mathurā haite sei yojaneka bāṭe || 80 ||
verses_en.wbw: mahavana name vana — the forest named Mahavana; yamuna-nikate — near the Yamuna; mathura haite — from Mathura; sei yojaneka bate — a yojana's way

verses_en.text:
To the west of it is the forest named Bilva,
half a yojana from Mathura, on the far bank.
verses_en.orig:
বিল্ব নামে বন আছে পশ্চিমে তাহার ।
অর্ধ যোজন সে মথুরা হইতে পার ॥ ৮১ ॥
verses_en.translit:
bilba nāme bana āche paścime tāhāra |
ardha yojana se mathurā haite pāra || 81 ||
verses_en.wbw: bilva name vana — the forest named Bilva; achhe pashchime tahara — is west of it; ardha yojana — half a yojana; se mathura haite para — across from Mathura

verses_en.text:
To the north of it is the forest named Loha;
to the north-east of it is the forest named Bhandira.
verses_en.orig:
তাহার উত্তরে আছে লোহ নামে বন ।
ভাণ্ডীর নামে বন আছে তাহার ঈশান ॥ ৮২ ॥
verses_en.translit:
tāhāra uttare āche loha nāme bana |
bhāṇḍīra nāme bana āche tāhāra īśāna || 82 ||
verses_en.wbw: tahara uttare — north of it; achhe loha name vana — is the forest named Loha; bhandira name vana — the forest named Bhandira; achhe tahara ishana — is north-east of it

verses_en.text:
These two forests lie together on the bank of the Yamuna;
from Mahavana, people say, three and a half yojanas.
verses_en.orig:
একত্রই দুই বন যমুনার কূলে ।
মহাবন হৈতে লোকে আউট যোজন বোলে ॥ ৮৩ ॥
verses_en.translit:
ekatrai dui bana yamunāra kūle |
mahābana haite loke āuṭa yojana bole || 83 ||
verses_en.wbw: ekatrai dui vana — these two forests together; yamunara kule — on the bank of the Yamuna; mahavana haite — from Mahavana; loke auta yojana bole — people say three and a half yojanas

verses_en.text: These are the twelve forests — the Mathura-mandala;
verses_en.orig:
এই দ্বাদশ বন মথুরামণ্ডল ।
কৃষ্ণের বিহার-স্থান দেখাব সকল ॥ ৮৪ ॥
verses_en.translit:
ei dbādaśa bana mathurāmaṇḍala |
kṛṣṇera bihāra-sthāna dekhāba sakala || 84 ||
verses_en.wbw: ei dvadasha vana — these twelve forests; mathura-mandala — the Mathura-mandala; krishnera vihara-sthana — the places of Krishna's pastimes; dekhaba sakala — I will show them all
